description: This file defines custom permission classes for a Django REST Framework project, specifically implementing permission logic that restricts access to admin users for certain API endpoints.

classes.name: IsAdminRole
classes.description: A custom permission class that grants access only to users with admin privileges, including Django superusers, staff, or members of the 'Admin' group.

methods.name: bool has_permission(self, request, view)
methods.description: Determines if the requesting user has permission by checking if they are an admin user.
